name: Rupertiweg 10A
description_md:
Rupertiweg 10A is a waymarked hiking route in Austria spanning 136.0 km. This hard national waymarked hiking network route is signposted as 10A and involves 1951 m of ascent and 2102 m of descent.

The walking time is about 39 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The difficulty is derived from distance and ascent. The route passes Inn within 100 m.
